caption: The drawing shows an octagonal water basin or pool, bordered by reddish-brown bricks with lighter mortar. The pool contains light blue water with visible reflections and slight ripples. Around the edge, the brickwork forms a raised border, and on one side, there are three brick steps leading up to the edge of the basin. The sides of the pool have a panel design, each section outlined with lines of small, evenly spaced reddish decorative elements near the top and bottom margins of the panels. There is some light green grass depicted near the base of the steps. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature, "Geoffrey Holt," appears below and to the right of the pool.
title: Mission Fountain
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
